notes.text: Demo plant, not a benchmark case. Built by Cowork from the public CSB case study of the Williams Olefins Plant, Geismar, Louisiana (report 2013-03-I-LA, Oct 2016). Scope: the propylene fractionator DA-406 and its two quench-water reboilers EA-425A/B only. Every value is cited to a CSB page or listed as 'assumed' in provenance.

The propylene fractionator separates propylene from propane. Its reboilers are shell-and-tube exchangers: the process fluid (mostly propane, with small amounts of propylene and heavier hydrocarbons) is on the shell side and enters at about 130 °F (54 °C); hot quench water from the plant's quench tower loop is on the tube side and enters at about 185 °F (85 °C).
A 2001 management-of-change added block valves on the shell-side inlet (16-inch) and outlet (18-inch) of each reboiler so that one reboiler could be isolated and cleaned while the other operated.
notes.source: CSB case study p. 15 fn. 21, p. 32

notes.text: The relief valves SV-421QA/QB on top of the fractionator DA-406 are the overpressure protection for the reboiler shells; a reboiler shell reaches them only through its shell-side piping to the column.
notes.source: CSB case study p. 10, p. 34 fn. 44

notes.text: Car-seal practice: only the in-service reboiler's 18-inch shell-side outlet valve is car sealed open; the standby reboiler's shell-side valves are closed and not car sealed ('only the in service exchanger is to be car sealed open', 2012 email).
Since February 2012 Reboiler B has been on standby, isolated from the process by its single closed shell-side inlet and outlet block valves; Reboiler A is in service.
Reboiler shell: about 18.5 ft long and over 5 ft in diameter (24 ft 8 in end to end), six tube passes, 3,020 tubes of 3/4 inch. MAWP 300 psig; hydrostatic test 450 psig.
notes.source: CSB case study p. 10 fn. 11 and fn. 13, p. 41

notes.text: The equilibrium vapour pressure of propane at ambient temperature is about 124 psig.
There is no equipment-specific procedure for these reboilers. The site uses a generic reboiler start-up procedure, last revised 1996, written for exchangers with the process fluid on the tube side.
Many contractor personnel work in the unit area during the day.
notes.source: CSB case study p. 12 fn. 14 (164 of 167 people reporting injuries were contractors)
